gate_model: HistGradientBoosting, same fixed hyperparameters as boosted_trees
selection_rule: Among rule_definitions and each learned model at its high_specificity point: keep those whose ICU outer-CV sensitivity is >= that of rule_definitions (untuned published definitions); choose the one with the fewest false alert starts per monitored hour on WILDPPG_TEST_IDS under the prior-window gate; break ties by AUROC. 2-of-3 persistence is reported, not used for selection.
